meta.display_name: ACM journals (TAPS -- The ACM Publishing System)
meta.status_detail: Round 1 (workspace proposal 3674c0c1) migration. citation_style was independently verified 2026-09-11 against acm.org/publications/taps/describing-figures and homes.cs.washington.edu/~spencer/taps ('the vast majority of ACM articles use numbered citations and references'), but reflects the numbered-bracket majority convention only, not the SIGGRAPH/SIGPLAN author-year exception. CAVEAT inherited from proposal 3674c0c1, not independently re-verified in this pass: ACM's own sub-formats (sigconf vs. the journal format) set opposite defaults for figure/table caption boldness, so figure_caption_bold and table_caption_bold are deliberately left absent from this preset (matching the original dict entry, which never set them) rather than picking one sub-format's default -- callers targeting SIGGRAPH/SIGPLAN venues should override citation_style explicitly too.

source.quote: the vast majority of ACM articles use numbered citations and references
source.note: Reflects the numbered-bracket majority convention (reference number in brackets), not the SIGGRAPH/SIGPLAN-sponsored-venue author-year exception -- callers targeting those venues should override explicitly. CAVEAT (inherited from proposal 3674c0c1, not independently re-verified in this pass): round-1 flagged that ACM's own sub-formats (sigconf vs. the journal format) set opposite defaults for figure/table caption boldness, so figure_caption_bold and table_caption_bold are deliberately left unset here rather than picking one sub-format's default.
